_comment: Golden vectors for the signed BODIES the server verifies. Generated from backend/auth.py (regenerated deliberately for crypto-core 5.0.0: the encryption key a 1 281-byte CatKDF P-384 + ML-KEM-768 key, the login challenge and the key attestation name its suite, wrapped keys carry v 5, the CatKDF alg and a key id; 4.0.0 before it made addresses SHA-384 digests and every digest in a body SHA-384), asserted by backend/tests/test_signed_bodies.py and by packages/crypto-core/test/byte-compat.test.js. Both sides must build these byte-for-byte or the signature fails; the point of a shared fixture is that neither side can be the one that is right. The inputs are low-entropy stand-ins on purpose — the bodies interpolate them verbatim, so realistic values would only make the vectors unreadable without testing anything more.
